at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Use money helpers for all amounts
at-0006.content: Convert every monetary input with `ledgerly.money.to_money` and round results with `ledgerly.money.round_money`; never do raw float arithmetic on prices. `to_money` rejects floats with `BillingError("float_amount")`, so callers must pass Decimal or str.
